rows.note: This is the everyday choice for an absence where the person did not ask for leave or permission.

example.english: He was unexcused today and still did not come to work.
example.traditional: 佢今日係冇請假嘅，仲唔返工喎。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam1 jat6 hai6 mou5 ceng2 gaa3 ge3 zung6 m4 faan1 gung1 wo3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose expression for being absent without an accepted reason, especially in notices and formal contexts.

example.english: The school notice says that unexcused absences will be subject to disciplinary action.
example.traditional: 校方通告指出，無故缺席會受處分。
example.jyutping: haau6 fong1 tung1 gou3 zi2 ceot1 mou4 gu3 kyut3 zik6 wui6 sau6 cyu2 fan1

rows.note: Use this specifically when a student misses a class without an accepted excuse.

example.english: Students with unexcused absences from class will lose conduct marks.
example.traditional: 學生無故缺課會扣操行分。
example.jyutping: hok6 saang1 mou4 gu3 kyut3 fo3 wui6 kau3 cou3 hang6 fan1
